    THE MAKING OF HARBOR RUN

    Original city. Shared craft.

    Harbor Run is an original arcade circuit inspired by early street racing games.

    Harbor Coupe and city assets authored in Blender for this game. The coupe includes original vinyl graphics, detailed wheels, lamps, interior and aero parts.

    Asphalt 01, Brick Wall 001 and Kloofendal partly cloudy daylight from Poly Haven, CC0. City models were authored in Blender for Harbor Run. Renderer: Three.js, MIT. Interface, game logic and sound are original.

    This first circuit includes three rivals and traffic. Police pursuits, career progression and vehicle upgrades are not included.
    Use a keyboard or gamepad to drive.
